safety_verdicts.content: Patient has tingling and numbness in the shoulder.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated mentions occasional shoulder pain with movement but does not state tingling/numbness in the shoulder.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Whether symptoms extend into the shoulder can slightly affect localization (e.g., cervical radiculopathy/brachial plexus vs distal entrapment), but the transcript supports only occasional shoulder pain with movement rather than clear shoulder tingling/numbness. This omission is unlikely to materially change urgent neurology referral/escalation decisions already driven by unilateral arm numbness/weakness and transient visual loss.

Omitting it (if it truly occurred) would more likely lead to some lost context/monitoring rather than a major change in immediate management.
